brief: Content marketing stack 2026 — research, drafting, scheduling, repurposing, analytics. Tools indie founders actually use.

slots.tagline: The central hub where every brief, draft, and calendar lives before anything ships.
slots.f1Body: Kanban and calendar views track every post from idea to published.
slots.f2Body: Brand voice docs, SOPs, and research live in one searchable home.
slots.f3Body: Native AI blocks draft summaries and fill tables automatically.

slots.tagline: Cites live sources so your content is accurate, deep, and actually trustworthy.
slots.f1Body: Every answer includes verified links you can quote with confidence.
slots.f2Body: Run multi-step investigations that compile into exportable briefs.
slots.f3Body: Switch between academic, web, and social sources for any topic.

slots.tagline: Turns scattered research notes into polished scripts, carousels, and newsletters fast.
slots.f1Body: Drop in research and maintain narrative consistency across long drafts.
slots.f2Body: Train on your best posts so output matches your brand voice.
slots.f3Body: Side-by-side editing for headlines, hooks, and CTA variations.

slots.tagline: Designs carousels, thumbnails, and web graphics that stop the scroll every time.
slots.f1Body: Resize carousels for every platform without rebuilding frames from scratch.
slots.f2Body: Reuse brand colors, type, and logos across every content format.
slots.f3Body: Export assets for your site or embed without extra design tools.

slots.tagline: Connects your entire stack to auto-publish, repurpose, and distribute without code.
slots.f1Body: Drag-and-drop scenarios replace coding for any content pipeline you need.
slots.f2Body: Route video to short clips, blog posts, and email automatically.
slots.f3Body: Built-in retries and logs keep your publishing calendar on time.

slots.tagline: Publishes long-form video and feeds clips, SEO, and community growth forever.
slots.f1Body: Second-largest search surface sends evergreen traffic for years to come.
slots.f2Body: Retention graphs and CTR data sharpen every future thumbnail hook.
slots.f3Body: One long video spawns Shorts, embeds, and newsletter snippets fast.

slots.ctaBody: Steal this indie marketing stack and start publishing consistently in 2026.
